items.title: The impact that AI will have on advertising, according to Sir Martin Sorrell
items.summary: Sir Martin Sorrell — the founder and executive chairman of S4Capital — sits down with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to discuss how Meta's (META) new Muse chatbot and other AI products will impact the advertising space.

items.title: Why most ads are terrible: Former Microsoft CSO
items.summary: Stagwell CEO, former Microsoft Chief Strategy Officer, and White House pollster Mark Penn sits down with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to break down why most modern digital ads fail, and how AI is completely rewriting the rules of what you buy.

items.title: Forget SPY: Invesco’s Fund Gives the Smallest S&P 500 Company the Same Say as the Largest
items.summary: SPY hands most of your money to a handful of giants, but one rival fund treats the smallest S&P 500 company as an equal to the largest. The tradeoff is stranger than it sounds, and the recent returns reveal a tension every index investor should weigh.
